hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty"); R=$(command -v ruff || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/ruff"); case "$f" in *.g.dart) ;; *.dart) dart format "$f" ;; */backend/*.py) "$R" check --select I --fix -q "$f"; "$R" format -q "$f" ;; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
